title: Preserve every row when inferring a single prediction field from records
body: ### Related Issues/PRs Related implementation history: #10160 introduced automatic single-output selection; #14680 moved the helper into the shared regression evaluation path. Neither extracts all rows in the record-oriented fallback. ### What changes are proposed in this pull request? When a model returns one dictionary per input row and `predictions` is omitted, `_extract_output_and_other_columns` infers the sole field from the first record but builds the output Series from that record's value alone. Numeric/text predictions lose all later rows; a list-valued prediction is instead expanded into separate rows. Infer the field name from the first record, then extract that field from every record, matching the existing explicit-field path. This keeps one output value per input row and allows regression evaluation to compute and log metrics for the whole batch. ### How is this PR tested? - [x] New unit/integration tests Ten focused tests have 5 failures and 5 passing controls on the base code. All 10 pass with the fix (`pytest -p pytest_mock -p pytest_timeout tests/evaluate/test_record_predictions.py -q`). Coverage includes numeric/text/list-valued records, a single record containing a vector, explicit-field controls, and the existing column-oriented dictionary convention. Native `mlflow.models.evaluate` calls verify all four regression rows and the persisted mean absolute error; the baseline automatic-selection call fails with inconsistent sample lengths `[4, 1]`. Pinned Ruff, Clint, character normalization and `git diff --check` pass. The large existing default-evaluator module could not be collected in this environment because its imports require PySpark; it is not claimed as tested. The full repository suite was not run. Full pre-commit initialization remains blocked by npm's `EALLOWGIT` restriction on the Prettier environment; Python checks were run directly. ### Does this PR require documentation update? - [x] No. ### Does this PR require updating the [MLflow Skills](https://github.com/mlflow/skills) repository? - [x] No. ### Release Notes #### Is this a user-facing change? - [x] Yes. Preserve all record-oriented predictions during automatic output-field selection. #### What component(s), interfaces, languages, and integrations does this PR affect? Components - [x] `area/evaluation`: MLflow model evaluation features, evaluation metrics, and evaluation workflows #### How should the PR be classified in the release notes? Choose one: - [x] `rn/bug-fix` - A user-facing bug fix worth mentioning in the release notes #### Is this PR a critical bugfix or security fix that should go into the next patch release? - [ ] This PR is critical and needs to be in the next patch release - [x] This PR can wait for the next minor release
